branch_title: Joey Moves Closer to See the Piece

selected_option.choice_text: Move closer to see the piece

sequence.speaker: Joey
sequence.text: Yay! I'm so happy we can build the tower together!
You didn't notice that Mia still needed more space. You both kept playing, but Mia wished you had checked in.

sections.heading: What Happened Before?
sections.body: Mia had quietly moved a little farther away. She looked a little sad, but she kept building on her own. Then you noticed a perfect piece for your tower in Mia's building area.

sections.heading: What Did You Pick?
sections.body: Move closer to see the piece

sections.heading: What Happened After?
sections.body: Mia kept playing, but she did not feel happy or relaxed. She still felt uncomfortable.

sections.heading: Let's Talk
questions: What could you have done differently, even if Mia did not ask again?
How can we tell if a friend is uncomfortable, even when they do not say it out loud?
